name: Corporate Action Amounts 79
definition: Specifies amounts in the framework of a corporate action event.

PostingAmount.name: Posting Amount
PostingAmount.definition: Amount of money that is to be/was posted to the account.

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Amount of money before any tax deductions have been made.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount of money after tax deductions have been made.

SolicitationFees.name: Solicitation Fees
SolicitationFees.definition: Cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event, for example consent fees or solicitation fees.

CashInLieuOfShare.name: Cash In Lieu Of Share
CashInLieuOfShare.definition: Cash disbursement in lieu of a fractional quantity of, for example, equity.

CapitalGain.name: Capital Gain
CapitalGain.definition: Amount of money distributed as the result of a capital gain.

InterestAmount.name: Interest Amount
InterestAmount.definition: Amount of money representing a coupon payment.

MarketClaimAmount.name: Market Claim Amount
MarketClaimAmount.definition: Amount of money resulting from a market claim.

IndemnityAmount.name: Indemnity Amount
IndemnityAmount.definition: Market claim/reverse market claim amount treated as an indemnity (whether net or gross).

ManufacturedDividendPaymentAmount.name: Manufactured Dividend Payment Amount
ManufacturedDividendPaymentAmount.definition: Any amount representative of a dividend/other income payment that is required to be paid by one person to another, under a contract or any other arrangement between the parties, for the transfer of the underlying securities. Manufactured payments are a compensation/substitute payment made by the holder of the securities to the original owner, to reflect the fact that the original owner does not receive the real dividend or interest.

ReinvestmentAmount.name: Reinvestment Amount
ReinvestmentAmount.definition: Amount of money reinvested in additional securities.

FullyFrankedAmount.name: Fully Franked Amount
FullyFrankedAmount.definition: Amount resulting from a fully franked dividend paid by a company; amount includes tax credit for companies that have made sufficient tax payments during the fiscal period.

UnfrankedAmount.name: Unfranked Amount
UnfrankedAmount.definition: Amount resulting from an unfranked dividend paid by a company; the amount does not include tax credit and is subject to withholding tax.

SundryOrOtherAmount.name: Sundry Or Other Amount
SundryOrOtherAmount.definition: Amount of money related to taxable income that cannot be categorised.

TaxFreeAmount.name: Tax Free Amount
TaxFreeAmount.definition: Amount of money that has not been subject to taxation.

TaxDeferredAmount.name: Tax Deferred Amount
TaxDeferredAmount.definition: Amount of income eligible for deferred taxation.

TaxReclaimAmount.name: Tax Reclaim Amount
TaxReclaimAmount.definition: Amount that was paid in excess of actual tax obligation and was reclaimed.

TaxCreditAmount.name: Tax Credit Amount
TaxCreditAmount.definition: Amount of taxes that have been previously paid in relation to the taxable event.

AdditionalTaxAmount.name: Additional Tax Amount
AdditionalTaxAmount.definition: Amount of additional taxes that cannot be categorised.

WithholdingTaxAmount.name: Withholding Tax Amount
WithholdingTaxAmount.definition: Amount of a cash distribution that will be withheld by the tax authorities of the jurisdiction of the issuer, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

SecondLevelTaxAmount.name: Second Level Tax Amount
SecondLevelTaxAmount.definition: Amount of money withheld by the jurisdiction other than the jurisdiction of the issuer’s country of tax incorporation, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible. It is levied in complement or offset of the withholding tax rate levied by the jurisdiction of the issuer’s tax domicile.

FiscalStampAmount.name: Fiscal Stamp Amount
FiscalStampAmount.definition: Amount of fiscal tax to apply.

ExecutingBrokerAmount.name: Executing Broker Amount
ExecutingBrokerAmount.definition: Amount of money paid to an executing broker as a commission.

RegulatoryFeesAmount.name: Regulatory Fees Amount
RegulatoryFeesAmount.definition: Amount of money charged by a regulatory authority, for example, Securities and Exchange fees.

ShippingFeesAmount.name: Shipping Fees Amount
ShippingFeesAmount.definition: All costs related to the physical delivery of documents such as stamps, postage, carrier fees, insurances or messenger services.

ChargesAmount.name: Charges Amount
ChargesAmount.definition: Amount of money paid for the provision of financial services that cannot be categorised by another qualifier.

CashAmountBroughtForward.name: Cash Amount Brought Forward
CashAmountBroughtForward.definition: Indicates cash retained from previous dividend.

CashAmountCarriedForward.name: Cash Amount Carried Forward
CashAmountCarriedForward.definition: Indicates the balance carried forward to next dividend.

NotionalDividendPayableAmount.name: Notional Dividend Payable Amount
NotionalDividendPayableAmount.definition: Amount of cash that would have been payable if the dividend had been taken in the form of cash rather than shares.

NotionalTaxAmount.name: Notional Tax Amount
NotionalTaxAmount.definition: Where new securities are issued in lieu of a cash dividend, the notional tax is the tax on the amount of cash that would have been paid.

TaxArrearsAmount.name: Tax Arrears Amount
TaxArrearsAmount.definition: Amount of money paid by the tax authorities in addition to the payment of the tax refund itself.

OriginalAmount.name: Original Amount
OriginalAmount.definition: Posting/settlement Amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

PrincipalOrCorpus.name: Principal Or Corpus
PrincipalOrCorpus.definition: Amount of money representing a distribution of a bond's principal, for example, repayment of outstanding debt.

RedemptionPremiumAmount.name: Redemption Premium Amount
RedemptionPremiumAmount.definition: Amount of money (not interest) in addition to the principal at the redemption of a bond.

IncomePortion.name: Income Portion
IncomePortion.definition: Amount relating to the underlying security for which income is distributed.

EUTaxRetentionAmount.name: EU Tax Retention Amount
EUTaxRetentionAmount.definition: Total amount of tax withheld at source in conformance with the EU Savings Directive.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Amount of interest that has been accrued in between coupon payment periods.

EqualisationAmount.name: Equalisation Amount
EqualisationAmount.definition: Portion of the fund distribution amount which represents the average accrued income included in the purchase price for units bought during the account period.

FATCATaxAmount.name: FATCA Tax Amount
FATCATaxAmount.definition: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act) related tax amount.

NRATaxAmount.name: NRA Tax Amount
NRATaxAmount.definition: Amount of tax related income subject to NRA (Non Resident Alien).

BackUpWithholdingTaxAmount.name: Back Up Withholding Tax Amount
BackUpWithholdingTaxAmount.definition: Amount of tax related to back up withholding.

TaxOnIncomeAmount.name: Tax On Income Amount
TaxOnIncomeAmount.definition: Amount of overall tax withheld at source by fund managers prior to considering the tax obligation of each unit holder.

DeemedAmount.name: Deemed Amount
DeemedAmount.definition: Amount of proceeds which is not actually paid to the security holder but on which withholding tax is applicable.

ForeignIncomeAmount.name: Foreign Income Amount
ForeignIncomeAmount.definition: Amount relating to a foreign income such as a conduit foreign income.

DeemedDividendAmount.name: Deemed Dividend Amount
DeemedDividendAmount.definition: Deemed amount resulting from the difference between the rate of dividend proceeds attributed to the security holder for the taxable year and the rate of dividend proceeds previously notified to the security holder in relation to cash distributions for the year.

DeemedFundAmount.name: Deemed Fund Amount
DeemedFundAmount.definition: Deemed amount resulting from the difference between the rate of the proceeds components comprising a fund payment attributed to the security holder for the taxable year and the rate of the fund proceeds previously notified to the security holder in relation to cash distributions for the year.

DeemedInterestAmount.name: Deemed Interest Amount
DeemedInterestAmount.definition: Deemed amount resulting from the difference between the rate of interest proceeds attributed to the security holder for the taxable year and the rate of interest proceeds previously notified to the security holder in relation to cash distributions for the year.

DeemedRoyaltiesAmount.name: Deemed Royalties Amount
DeemedRoyaltiesAmount.definition: Deemed amount resulting from the difference between the rate of royalty proceeds attributed to the security holder for the taxable year and the rate of royalty proceeds previously notified to the security holder in relation to cash distributions for the year.

AdjustedSubscriptionAmount.name: Adjusted Subscription Amount
AdjustedSubscriptionAmount.definition: Amount of money debited or credited to adjust for the difference between the estimated and the final subscription rate for Rights Exercise events.

RefundedSubscriptionAmount.name: Refunded Subscription Amount
RefundedSubscriptionAmount.definition: Amount of money refunded from the original subscription cost for a Rights Exercise event.  This occurs when the event is prorated and the subscription cost relating to the unaffected (unaccepted) balance is returned to the holder.

BuyUpAmount.name: Buy Up Amount
BuyUpAmount.definition: Amount of cash debited in the context of a buy up option.
